mapper.select: SELECT ot.id AS taskId, ot.work_order_id AS workOrderId, wo.erp_order_no AS erpOrderNo, wo.product_code AS productCode, wo.product_name AS productName, ot.operation_code AS operationCode, ot.operation_name AS operationName, ot.seq, ot.plan_qty AS planQty, ot.completed_qty AS completedQty, ot.status AS taskStatus, wo.status AS workOrderStatus, ot.priority, ot.planned_start AS plannedStart FROM operation_task ot INNER JOIN work_order wo ON wo.id = ot.work_order_id WHERE ot.assigned_to = #{workerId} AND ot.status <> 2 AND wo.status NOT IN (5, 6) ORDER BY ot.priority DESC, ot.planned_start ASC, ot.id ASC
